<a id="testing"></a>

## Testing

### Test environment

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| API base URL | `https://ecom-api-test.paynet.md` |
| Hosted checkout form URL | `https://test.paynet.md/ecom/checkout` |
| API username / password | `771064` / `sLgMnGWJ` |
| Merchant code | `265505` |
| Sale area code | `onlidocumentation_md` |
| Secret key for the hosted checkout signature | `F90D6485-9CCC-458B-96A3-8958AF9B4458` |
| Secret key for notifications | `D9873689-E5F8-4272-A67F-0D8BA3F9BAA7` |

These credentials are shared by everyone testing on this portal: other people's test payments are visible in searches and statements. Ask Paynet for your own test merchant if you need an isolated environment.

### Test card

| Card | Expiry | CVV | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Visa `4111 1111 1111 1111` | `12/27` | `777` | successful payment |

Test cards can only reproduce a successful payment: there are no cards for declined or 3-D Secure payments. You still need to implement decline handling and test it with mocked API responses: `status` = `5` and the customer returning to `LinkUrlCancel` (see [Failed payment](#errors-and-statuses)). When a real payment fails, the customer is simply redirected to `LinkUrlCancel` and no notification is sent.

### Rules that make tests fail

- **Reused `Order`.** The same `Order` with different data, or an `Order` that is already paid, fails with `500 TECHNICAL_ERROR`. The portal generates a new `Order` for you (current time in milliseconds).
- **`ExpiryDate` in the past.** Use a future date in Chișinău local time. The portal sets it to the end of tomorrow.
- **Amounts in MDL instead of minor units.** `100` means 1.00 MDL.
- **Expired token.** Tokens live about 4 hours; call `/auth` again after `401`.
- **Products don't add up.** If you send `Products`, send all product fields and keep `Amount` values consistent with the service `Amount`.

### Test scenarios

| # | Scenario | How | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Authenticate | `POST /auth` with test credentials | `200`, `access_token` |
| 2 | Wrong password | `POST /auth` with a wrong password | error `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` |
| 3 | Create order | `POST /api/order` | `200`, `paymentId`, `paymentLink`, `status` `1` |
| 4 | Repeat the same request | send scenario 3 again unchanged | same `paymentId` and `paymentLink` |
| 5 | Same `Order`, other amount | change `Amount`, keep `Order` | `500`, `TECHNICAL_ERROR` |
| 6 | Invalid request | `POST /api/order` without `Services` | `400`, `INVALID_PARAMETER` |
| 7 | No token | `POST /api/order` without `Authorization` | `401`, `UNAUTHORIZED` |
| 8 | Pay | open `paymentLink`, pay with the test card | redirect to `LinkUrlSuccess` |
| 9 | Status | `GET /api/order/merchant/{Order}` | payment with `paidDate` set |
| 10 | Unknown order | `GET /api/order/{id}` with a random ID | `404`, `NOT_FOUND_RECORD` |
| 11 | Notification | **Notification simulator** → your URL | your handler verifies `Hash`, returns `200` |
| 12 | Wrong hash | send a notification with a changed `Amount` | your handler rejects it |
| 13 | Duplicate notification | send the same notification twice | your handler processes it once |
| 14 | Hosted checkout | **Checkout form (try it)** | Paynet test payment page opens |
| 15 | Refund | `POST /api/order/refund` for a paid payment | `200`; `status` becomes `5` (full) or `6` (partial) |
| 16 | Refund above the paid amount | `RefundType` `partial`, `Amount` above `PaidAmount` | `400 INVALID_PARAMETER` |
| 17 | Save a card (if enabled for your `SaleAreaCode`) | `POST /api/order` with `Customer`, pay keeping the "save card" checkbox | the `PAID` notification contains `CardLinkHash` |
| 18 | Pay with a saved card (if enabled) | `POST /api/order` with `CardLinkHash` and the same `Customer` | the Paynet page shows the saved card |
| 19 | Customer left without paying | open `paymentLink`, close the page, open the link again | `status` stays `1`, payment is still possible |

### Testing from this portal

The "Test API Request" buttons call the test API directly from your browser. This works on the official portal domain. If you open a copy of the portal from another address, the browser may block the calls (CORS); use cURL or Postman instead. A Postman collection can be downloaded from the sidebar.


---

<a id="go-live"></a>

## Go-live checklist

### Before you switch to production

**Credentials and configuration**

- [ ] You received from Paynet: production API user, merchant code, sale area code and **two** secret keys (hosted checkout signature and notifications). Production access is sent to your company administrator's email; it takes from 5 minutes to several days depending on the features you connect.
- [ ] All test values are replaced with production ones: **production keys and credentials differ from the test ones**.
- [ ] Your code uses the production URLs: API `https://ecom-api.paynet.md`, hosted checkout form `https://paynet.md/ecom/checkout`.
- [ ] Secrets are stored in server configuration (environment variables, vault), not in code or front-end.
- [ ] Your callback URL (HTTPS) is registered with Paynet.
- [ ] `LinkUrlSuccess` and `LinkUrlCancel` point to production pages.

**Payments**

- [ ] Every shop order gets its own unique `Order` number, also after restarts and in parallel requests.
- [ ] `ExpiryDate` is computed in Chișinău local time (`Europe/Chisinau`), for example now + 1 day, not hard-coded.
- [ ] Amounts are sent in minor units and match the cart total.
- [ ] Hosted checkout: the signature is computed on the server and passes the [test vectors](#signatures).

**Notifications**

- [ ] The handler verifies the `Hash` header with the notification secret key.
- [ ] The handler reads `Payment.Id` and `Payment.ExternalId` (exact spelling).
- [ ] The handler is idempotent (one `Payment.Id` = one fulfilment).
- [ ] The handler checks that `PaidAmount` equals `Amount` (unless you have an agreed promotion with Paynet).
- [ ] The handler answers `200` only after the order is saved.
- [ ] A fallback job checks unpaid orders with `GET /api/order/{paymentId}` if no notification arrived. Failed payments are not notified.

**Operations**

- [ ] The token is cached and refreshed on `401`.
- [ ] Errors are logged with `traceId`.
- [ ] You do not mark orders as paid just because the customer returned to `LinkUrlSuccess`.
- [ ] Refund and statement flows are tested if you use them.

### After launch

- Make one real low-value payment and refund it.
- Reconcile the first day's payments with the statement (`GET /api/statement`): you receive `PaidAmount` minus the Paynet commission.


---

<a id="api-reference"></a>

## API reference (server-to-server)

Base URL (test): `https://ecom-api-test.paynet.md`. All endpoints except `/auth` require `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

### POST /api/linked-cards/unlink — Delete linked card

The delete linked card method is used to deactivate and remove a previously linked card from the Paynet system. When this method is executed, the specified card token is permanently invalidated, and the card is unlinked from the customer account. As a result, the token can no longer be used for any payment operations, including recurring or one-click payments. To perform this request, the Partner must provide the unique card identifier (CardLinkHash), the corresponding SaleAreaCode, and the CustomerCode associated with the card. This method ensures that sensitive payment credentials are securely removed and prevents any further unauthorized or unintended use.

Request body (`DeleteLinkedCardRequest`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CardLinkHash` | string | yes | The unique hash identifying the specific card to be unlinked. |
| `SaleAreaCode` | string | yes | The code identifying the specific sale area or merchant environment. |
| `CustomerCode` | string | yes | The unique identifier or code of the customer who owns the linked card. |

Request example:

```json
{
  "CardLinkHash": "1037153_b3f50103610e4fe9948ff8db553151f3",
  "SaleAreaCode": "onlidocumentation_md",
  "CustomerCode": "customer_code"
}
```

Response `200` — Success executed unlink card.:

```json
{
  "responseCode": "SUCCESS"
}
```

Response `400` — Invalid request parameters.:

```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "message": "One or more entered parameters are incorrect.",
  "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
  "traceId": "9b9346f9-f83a-465d-ac8d-dc382c460c22",
  "details": "The invalid parameter is: XXXX"
}
```

Response `401` — Access denied due to invalid or missing authentication token.:

```json
{
  "Status": 401,
  "Message": "Access denied. The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or has expired.",
  "Code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
  "TraceId": "84ec3ba3-6afc-4d22-8a0e-7113a59c82cc"
}
```

Response `404` — Record not found.:

```json
{
  "status": 404,
  "message": "Record not found",
  "code": "NOT_FOUND_RECORD",
  "traceId": "16ce780d-2e89-47b8-9cd2-6d0d136d9816",
  "details": "No records were found for the provided data"
}
```

Response `500` — Internal server error occurred while processing the request.:

```json
{
  "status": 500,
  "message": "One or more errors occurred.",
  "code": "TECHNICAL_ERROR",
  "traceId": "c546f06c-3674-4b55-8e0f-ce8aac66f49f",
  "details": "Please verify the transmitted data and try again, or contact support."
}
```

### POST /api/order — Create an order

In order to perform a payment via Paynet API, the payment must first be registered in the Paynet system. The Create order method is used to create (register) a new payment order by transmitting the required payment details from the Partner’s system to Paynet. Upon successful registration, Paynet generates and returns a unique payment identifier (Payment ID). This Payment ID is then used to redirect the customer to the Paynet payment page, where the user can review, confirm, and complete the payment. In this model, direct server-to-server communication between the Partner and Paynet is required. Data signing is not mandatory, as authentication is handled via an authorization token.

Request body (`PaymentRequest`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Order` | integer (int64) | yes | The unique identifier for the order. |
| `SaleAreaCode` | string | yes | The code representing the sale area or merchant location. |
| `LinkUrlSuccess` | string | yes | The URL to redirect to upon a successful payment. |
| `LinkUrlCancel` | string | yes | The URL to redirect to if the payment is canceled. |
| `CardLinkHash` | string | no | (Optional) Linked-card hash. If CardLinkHash is provided, the full Customer object (Code, NameFirst, NameLast, email, PhoneNumber) becomes required. |
| `Customer` | object | no | Represents the customer details for a payment. |
| `Customer.Code` | string | yes | The unique code or identifier for the customer. |
| `Customer.NameFirst` | string | no | (Optional) The customer's first name. |
| `Customer.NameLast` | string | no | (Optional) The customer's last name. |
| `Customer.email` | string | no | (Optional) The customer's email address. |
| `Customer.PhoneNumber` | string | no | (Optional) The customer's phone number. |
| `Currency` | integer (int32) | yes | The currency code. |
| `ExpiryDate` | string (date-time) | yes | The expiration date and time for this payment request. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, Chisinau local time (Europe/Chisinau); must be in the future. |
| `Services` | array | yes | The list of services included in this payment. |
| `Services[].Name` | string | yes | The name of the service. |
| `Services[].Description` | string | yes | The description of the service. |
| `Services[].Amount` | integer (int64) | yes | The total amount for this service. |
| `Services[].Products` | array | no | (Optional) A list of specific products under this service. If at least one Products field is provided, all Product fields become required. |
| `Services[].Products[].LineNo` | integer (int32) | yes | The line number or position of the product in the list. |
| `Services[].Products[].Name` | string | yes | The name of the product. |
| `Services[].Products[].Description` | string | yes | (Optional) The description of the product. |
| `Services[].Products[].Code` | string | yes | (Optional) Partner product code. |
| `Services[].Products[].UnitPrice` | integer (int64) | yes | The price per single unit of the product. |
| `Services[].Products[].Quantity` | integer (int64) | yes | The quantity of the product being purchased. |
| `Services[].Products[].Amount` | integer (int64) | yes | The total amount for this quantity (usually UnitPrice * Quantity). |
| `Services[].Products[].TotalAmount` | integer (int64) | yes | The final total amount including any taxes or discounts. |
| `MoneyType` | string | yes | Payment methods shown to the customer: "All" — all methods enabled for the merchant; "Card" — card (Visa/Mastercard), Apple Pay, Google Pay; "Paynet" — Paynet wallet; "MIA" — MIA instant payments; "CashInvoice" — cash invoice. Values: `All`, `Card`, `Paynet`, `MIA`, `CashInvoice`. |
| `Lang` | string | yes | UI language for payment page (example: RO or RU or EN). |

Request example:

```json
{
  "Order": 1762444800000,
  "SaleAreaCode": "onlidocumentation_md",
  "LinkUrlSuccess": "https://shop.example/payment/success",
  "LinkUrlCancel": "https://shop.example/payment/cancel",
  "Customer": {
    "Code": "464566161",
    "NameFirst": "First Name",
    "NameLast": "Last Name",
    "email": "customer@example.com",
    "PhoneNumber": "37360000000"
  },
  "Currency": 498,
  "ExpiryDate": "2026-12-31T23:59:59",
  "Services": [
    {
      "Name": "Demo eShop",
      "Description": "Order #1762444800000",
      "Amount": 300
    }
  ],
  "MoneyType": "Card",
  "Lang": "EN"
}
```

Response `200` — Order created. Real response from the test environment for the request example (status 1 = registered, not paid yet).:

```json
{
  "paymentId": 328731,
  "paymentLink": "https://test.paynet.md/ecom/getecom/328731?s=8fa1bd0923368d3bb700fccacc263735",
  "cardLinkHash": null,
  "status": 1,
  "message": null,
  "order": 1762444800000,
  "merchantCode": "265505",
  "saleAreaCode": "onlidocumentation_md",
  "linkUrlSuccess": "https://shop.example/payment/success",
  "linkUrlCancel": "https://shop.example/payment/cancel",
  "signature": "8fa1bd0923368d3bb700fccacc263735",
  "amount": {
    "requestAmount": 300,
    "requestCurrency": 498,
    "amount": 300,
    "paidAmount": null
  },
  "customer": {
    "code": "464566161",
    "nameFirst": "First Name",
    "nameLast": "Last Name",
    "email": "customer@example.com",
    "country": null,
    "city": null,
    "address": null,
    "phoneNumber": "37360000000",
    "cardLinkHash": null
  },
  "payer": null,
  "expiryDate": "2026-12-31 23:59:59",
  "registered": "2026-11-09 18:16:41",
  "paidDate": null,
  "services": [
    {
      "name": "Demo eShop",
      "description": "Order #1762444800000",
      "amount": 300,
      "products": [
        {
          "lineNo": 1,
          "name": "Demo eShop",
          "description": "Order #1762444800000",
          "unitPrice": 300,
          "unitProduct": null,
          "quantity": 100,
          "amount": 300,
          "totalAmount": 300
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "moneyType": "Card"
}
```

Response `400` — Invalid request parameters.:

```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "message": "One or more entered parameters are incorrect.",
  "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
  "traceId": "9b9346f9-f83a-465d-ac8d-dc382c460c22",
  "details": "The invalid parameter is: XXXX"
}
```

Response `401` — Access denied due to invalid or missing authentication token.:

```json
{
  "Status": 401,
  "Message": "Access denied. The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or has expired.",
  "Code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
  "TraceId": "84ec3ba3-6afc-4d22-8a0e-7113a59c82cc"
}
```

Response `500` — Internal server error occurred while processing the request.:

```json
{
  "status": 500,
  "message": "One or more errors occurred.",
  "code": "TECHNICAL_ERROR",
  "traceId": "c546f06c-3674-4b55-8e0f-ce8aac66f49f",
  "details": "Please verify the transmitted data and try again, or contact support."
}
```

### GET /api/order/{id} — Get a payment info by payment id

The get payment info method is used to retrieve detailed information about a specific payment using its unique identifier (PaymentId). To perform this request, the Partner must provide the payment ID in the request URL. Paynet will return the current status of the payment along with all relevant details, such as amount, currency, transaction status, and associated metadata. This method allows the Partner to verify the payment status, track transaction progress, and obtain up-to-date information about a previously registered payment.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer (int64) | yes | The unique identifier of the payment transaction to retrieve. |

Response `200` — Payment found. Real response from the test environment (status 1 = registered, not paid yet).:

### GET /api/order/merchant/{id} — Get a payment info by merchant order id

### GET /api/order/search — Get transaction list

The get transaction list method is used to retrieve a list of payments within a specified date and time interval. To perform this request, the Partner must provide the from and to parameters in the query string, defining the start and end of the search period. Paynet will return a collection of transactions that were created or processed within the specified timeframe. Each transaction record includes relevant details such as payment ID, amount, currency, status, and timestamps. This method allows the Partner to perform transaction monitoring, reporting, and reconciliation over a defined period.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | string (date-time) | yes | The starting date and time of the search interval. |
| `to` | query | string (date-time) | yes | The ending date and time of the search interval. |

Response `200` — Payments found for the period.:

Response `400` — One or more entered parameters are incorrect.:

```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "message": "One or more entered parameters are incorrect.",
  "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
  "traceId": "9697f2c8-b1c2-490a-84b3-8adda9bc22e9",
  "details": "The invalid parameter is: dateStart | dateFinish"
}
```

Response `401` — Access denied due to invalid or missing authentication token.:

```json
{
  "Status": 401,
  "Message": "Access denied. The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or has expired.",
  "Code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
  "TraceId": "84ec3ba3-6afc-4d22-8a0e-7113a59c82cc"
}
```

Response `500` — Internal server error occurred while processing the request.:

```json
{
  "status": 500,
  "message": "One or more errors occurred.",
  "code": "TECHNICAL_ERROR",
  "traceId": "6bc2b683-e796-43ae-9775-6d9f116675a6",
  "details": "Please verify the transmitted data and try again, or contact support."
}
```

### POST /api/order/refund — Refund a payment

The refund method is used to return funds for a previously completed payment. To perform a refund, the Partner must send the original PaymentId, refund amount, currency, sale area code, refund type, and the reason for the refund. The refund can be processed as either a full refund or a partial refund, depending on the RefundType and the amount provided in the request. After the refund request is processed, Paynet returns the result of the operation, allowing the Partner to confirm whether the refund was successfully registered and executed in the Paynet system.

Request body (`RefundRequest`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PaymentId` | integer (int64) | yes | The unique internal identifier of the original payment transaction to be refunded. |
| `SaleAreaCode` | string | yes | The code identifying the specific sale area or point of sale where the original transaction occurred. |
| `RefundType` | string | yes | The type of refund: "full" or "partial". Values: `full`, `partial`. |
| `Amount` | integer (int64) | yes | The exact amount to be refunded. |
| `Currency` | integer (int32) | yes | The numeric ISO code of the currency for the refund amount. |
| `Reason` | string | yes | A descriptive reason or justification for processing the refund. |

Request example:

```json
{
  "PaymentId": 296901,
  "Amount": 50000,
  "SaleAreaCode": "onlidocumentation_md",
  "Currency": 498,
  "RefundType": "full",
  "Reason": "Was customer error!"
}
```

Response `200` — Refund done. Real response from the test environment. eventDate uses the format dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss.:

```json
{
  "paymentId": 328733,
  "saleAreaCode": "onlidocumentation_md",
  "customer": "464566161",
  "eventDate": "09.11.2026 18:17:54",
  "refundType": "full",
  "currency": 498,
  "amount": 400,
  "merchant": "265505",
  "cardMask": "411111******1111",
  "cardLinkHash": null,
  "moneyType": "CYBER_SOURCE"
}
```

Response `401` — Access denied due to invalid or missing authentication token.:

```json
{
  "Status": 401,
  "Message": "Access denied. The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or has expired.",
  "Code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
  "TraceId": "84ec3ba3-6afc-4d22-8a0e-7113a59c82cc"
}
```

Response `500` — Internal server error occurred while processing the request.:

```json
{
  "status": 500,
  "message": "One or more errors occurred.",
  "code": "TECHNICAL_ERROR",
  "traceId": "6bc2b683-e796-43ae-9775-6d9f116675a6",
  "details": "Please verify the transmitted data and try again, or contact support."
}
```

### GET /api/statement — Get statement

Retrieves a list of payment transactions for a specified period based on the provided start and end dates. Used for generating statements and transaction reporting.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dateStart` | query | string (date-time) | yes | The starting date of the statement period. |
| `dateFinish` | query | string (date-time) | yes | The ending date of the statement period. |
| `accountId` | query | integer (int32) | no | (Optional) The specific account identifier to filter the statement. |

Response `200` — Statement for the period.:

Response `400` — One or more entered parameters are incorrect.:

```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "message": "One or more entered parameters are incorrect.",
  "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
  "traceId": "9697f2c8-b1c2-490a-84b3-8adda9bc22e9",
  "details": "The invalid parameter is: dateStart | dateFinish"
}
```

Response `401` — Access denied due to invalid or missing authentication token.:

```json
{
  "Status": 401,
  "Message": "Access denied. The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or has expired.",
  "Code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
  "TraceId": "84ec3ba3-6afc-4d22-8a0e-7113a59c82cc"
}
```

Response `500` — Internal server error occurred while processing the request.:

```json
{
  "status": 500,
  "message": "One or more errors occurred.",
  "code": "TECHNICAL_ERROR",
  "traceId": "6bc2b683-e796-43ae-9775-6d9f116675a6",
  "details": "Please verify the transmitted data and try again, or contact support."
}
```

### GET /api/statement/download — Download statement

Generates the merchant statement for the period from dateStart to dateFinish and returns it as an Excel (.xlsx) file. The period must not exceed 31 days.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dateStart` | query | string (date-time) | yes | The starting date of the report period. |
| `dateFinish` | query | string (date-time) | yes | The ending date of the report period (must be within 31 days of the start date). |

Response `200` — Statement as an .xlsx file.:

Response `400` — Invalid request parameters.:

```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "message": "One or more entered parameters are incorrect.",
  "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
  "traceId": "cf5573ee-4749-4190-8a1a-881ee53e7c0a",
  "details": "The invalid parameter is: dateStart | dateFinish"
}
```

Response `401` — Access denied due to invalid or missing authentication token.:

```json
{
  "Status": 401,
  "Message": "Access denied. The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or has expired.",
  "Code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
  "TraceId": "84ec3ba3-6afc-4d22-8a0e-7113a59c82cc"
}
```

Response `500` — Internal server error occurred while processing the request.:

```json
{
  "status": 500,
  "message": "One or more errors occurred.",
  "code": "TECHNICAL_ERROR",
  "traceId": "6bc2b683-e796-43ae-9775-6d9f116675a6",
  "details": "Please verify the transmitted data and try again, or contact support."
}
```

### POST /auth — Authentication and authorization

To access the Paynet service and complete authorization, you need to obtain an authorization token. You can get this token by calling the service method described below and providing the parameters (username and password) received during partner registration.

Request body (`AuthRequest`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grantType` | string | yes | The authorization grant type (e.g., "password"). |
| `username` | string | yes | The user's username. |
| `password` | string | yes | The user's password in plain text. |

Request example:

```json
{
  "grantType": "password",
  "username": "771064",
  "password": "sLgMnGWJ"
}
```

Response `200` — Success executed authentication.:

```json
{
  "access_token": "Ccxl7QQiMEoakkrUoiUn8PIgcmSN2ouP3XNjSmgqUH-Dn8UDg0...........",
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "expires_in": 14399
}
```

Response `500` — Request failed. See the error body.:

```json
[
  {
    "status": 500,
    "message": "Wrong credentials",
    "code": "AUTHENTICATION_FAILED",
    "traceId": "ab2002e6-50e7-4cea-a112-eadbddf83505",
    "details": null
  }
]
```

### Schemas

#### AuthRequest

The authentication request model.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grantType` | string | yes | The authorization grant type (e.g., "password"). |
| `username` | string | yes | The user's username. |
| `password` | string | yes | The user's password in plain text. |

#### Customer

Represents the customer details for a payment.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Code` | string | yes | The unique code or identifier for the customer. |
| `NameFirst` | string | no | (Optional) The customer's first name. |
| `NameLast` | string | no | (Optional) The customer's last name. |
| `email` | string | no | (Optional) The customer's email address. |
| `PhoneNumber` | string | no | (Optional) The customer's phone number. |

#### DeleteLinkedCardRequest

Represents the payload required to unlink a saved payment card.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CardLinkHash` | string | yes | The unique hash identifying the specific card to be unlinked. |
| `SaleAreaCode` | string | yes | The code identifying the specific sale area or merchant environment. |
| `CustomerCode` | string | yes | The unique identifier or code of the customer who owns the linked card. |

#### ErrorModel

Represents a standardized error response returned by the API.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | integer (int32) | no | Gets or sets the HTTP status code associated with the error (e.g., 400, 401, 500). |
| `message` | string | yes | Gets or sets a human-readable, descriptive error message intended for the client. |
| `code` | string | yes | Gets or sets the internal business logic error code or its string representation. |
| `traceId` | string | no | Gets or sets an optional unique identifier used for request tracing and debugging in the logs. |
| `details` | string | no | Gets or sets optional technical details or additional context regarding the error (e.g., specific validation failures). |

#### PaymentRequest

Represents the payload for initiating a payment request. Fields not marked as required are optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Order` | integer (int64) | yes | The unique identifier for the order. |
| `SaleAreaCode` | string | yes | The code representing the sale area or merchant location. |
| `LinkUrlSuccess` | string | yes | The URL to redirect to upon a successful payment. |
| `LinkUrlCancel` | string | yes | The URL to redirect to if the payment is canceled. |
| `CardLinkHash` | string | no | (Optional) Linked-card hash. If CardLinkHash is provided, the full Customer object (Code, NameFirst, NameLast, email, PhoneNumber) becomes required. |
| `Customer` | object | no | Represents the customer details for a payment. |
| `Customer.Code` | string | yes | The unique code or identifier for the customer. |
| `Customer.NameFirst` | string | no | (Optional) The customer's first name. |
| `Customer.NameLast` | string | no | (Optional) The customer's last name. |
| `Customer.email` | string | no | (Optional) The customer's email address. |
| `Customer.PhoneNumber` | string | no | (Optional) The customer's phone number. |
| `Currency` | integer (int32) | yes | The currency code. |
| `ExpiryDate` | string (date-time) | yes | The expiration date and time for this payment request. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, Chisinau local time (Europe/Chisinau); must be in the future. |
| `Services` | array | yes | The list of services included in this payment. |
| `Services[].Name` | string | yes | The name of the service. |
| `Services[].Description` | string | yes | The description of the service. |
| `Services[].Amount` | integer (int64) | yes | The total amount for this service. |
| `Services[].Products` | array | no | (Optional) A list of specific products under this service. If at least one Products field is provided, all Product fields become required. |
| `Services[].Products[].LineNo` | integer (int32) | yes | The line number or position of the product in the list. |
| `Services[].Products[].Name` | string | yes | The name of the product. |
| `Services[].Products[].Description` | string | yes | (Optional) The description of the product. |
| `Services[].Products[].Code` | string | yes | (Optional) Partner product code. |
| `Services[].Products[].UnitPrice` | integer (int64) | yes | The price per single unit of the product. |
| `Services[].Products[].Quantity` | integer (int64) | yes | The quantity of the product being purchased. |
| `Services[].Products[].Amount` | integer (int64) | yes | The total amount for this quantity (usually UnitPrice * Quantity). |
| `Services[].Products[].TotalAmount` | integer (int64) | yes | The final total amount including any taxes or discounts. |
| `MoneyType` | string | yes | Payment methods shown to the customer: "All" — all methods enabled for the merchant; "Card" — card (Visa/Mastercard), Apple Pay, Google Pay; "Paynet" — Paynet wallet; "MIA" — MIA instant payments; "CashInvoice" — cash invoice. Values: `All`, `Card`, `Paynet`, `MIA`, `CashInvoice`. |
| `Lang` | string | yes | UI language for payment page (example: RO or RU or EN). |

#### Product

Represents a single product item within a service.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LineNo` | integer (int32) | yes | The line number or position of the product in the list. |
| `Name` | string | yes | The name of the product. |
| `Description` | string | yes | (Optional) The description of the product. |
| `Code` | string | yes | (Optional) Partner product code. |
| `UnitPrice` | integer (int64) | yes | The price per single unit of the product. |
| `Quantity` | integer (int64) | yes | The quantity of the product being purchased. |
| `Amount` | integer (int64) | yes | The total amount for this quantity (usually UnitPrice * Quantity). |
| `TotalAmount` | integer (int64) | yes | The final total amount including any taxes or discounts. |

#### RefundRequest

Represents the payload required to initiate a refund for a specific payment transaction.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PaymentId` | integer (int64) | yes | The unique internal identifier of the original payment transaction to be refunded. |
| `SaleAreaCode` | string | yes | The code identifying the specific sale area or point of sale where the original transaction occurred. |
| `RefundType` | string | yes | The type of refund: "full" or "partial". Values: `full`, `partial`. |
| `Amount` | integer (int64) | yes | The exact amount to be refunded. |
| `Currency` | integer (int32) | yes | The numeric ISO code of the currency for the refund amount. |
| `Reason` | string | yes | A descriptive reason or justification for processing the refund. |

#### Service

Represents a service included in the payment request.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Name` | string | yes | The name of the service. |
| `Description` | string | yes | The description of the service. |
| `Amount` | integer (int64) | yes | The total amount for this service. |
| `Products` | array | no | (Optional) A list of specific products under this service. If at least one Products field is provided, all Product fields become required. |
| `Products[].LineNo` | integer (int32) | yes | The line number or position of the product in the list. |
| `Products[].Name` | string | yes | The name of the product. |
| `Products[].Description` | string | yes | (Optional) The description of the product. |
| `Products[].Code` | string | yes | (Optional) Partner product code. |
| `Products[].UnitPrice` | integer (int64) | yes | The price per single unit of the product. |
| `Products[].Quantity` | integer (int64) | yes | The quantity of the product being purchased. |
| `Products[].Amount` | integer (int64) | yes | The total amount for this quantity (usually UnitPrice * Quantity). |
| `Products[].TotalAmount` | integer (int64) | yes | The final total amount including any taxes or discounts. |

#### AuthResponse

Successful authentication response.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `access_token` | string | no | Bearer token for the Authorization header. |
| `token_type` | string | no | Always "bearer". |
| `expires_in` | integer | no | Token lifetime in seconds (about 4 hours). |

#### PaymentResponse

Payment object returned by create/get endpoints.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `paymentId` | integer (int64) | no | Paynet payment ID. Store it with your order. |
| `paymentLink` | string | no | URL of the Paynet payment page. Redirect the customer here. |
| `cardLinkHash` | string | no | Saved card hash (linked-card scenarios). |
| `status` | integer | no | Payment status code. A new order has status 1. |
| `message` | string | no |  |
| `order` | integer (int64) | no | Your order number (Order). |
| `merchantCode` | string | no |  |
| `saleAreaCode` | string | no |  |
| `linkUrlSuccess` | string | no |  |
| `linkUrlCancel` | string | no |  |
| `signature` | string | no |  |
| `amount` | object | no |  |
| `amount.requestAmount` | integer | no |  |
| `amount.requestCurrency` | integer | no |  |
| `amount.amount` | integer | no |  |
| `amount.amountCurrency` | integer | no |  |
| `customer` | object | no |  |
| `customer.code` | string | no |  |
| `customer.nameFirst` | string | no |  |
| `customer.nameLast` | string | no |  |
| `customer.email` | string | no |  |
| `customer.country` | string | no |  |
| `customer.city` | string | no |  |
| `customer.address` | string | no |  |
| `customer.phoneNumber` | string | no |  |
| `customer.cardLinkHash` | string | no |  |
| `payer` | object | no | Payer details after payment. |
| `payer.cardMask` | string | no |  |
| `payer.rrn` | string | no |  |
| `payer.cardExpireMonth` | string | no |  |
| `payer.cardExpireYear` | string | no |  |
| `payer.cardIssuer` | string | no |  |
| `payer.cardLinkHash` | string | no |  |
| `payer.moneyType` | string | no |  |
| `payer.payerName` | string | no |  |
| `payer.payerSurname` | string | no |  |
| `payer.payerIDNP` | string | no |  |
| `expiryDate` | string | no | Format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss". |
| `registered` | string | no |  |
| `paidDate` | string | no | Set when the payment is paid. |
| `services` | array | no |  |
| `moneyType` | string | no |  |
